prompt: Provide a description of a safety-critical scenario where the ego vehicle is negotiating crossing traffic at an intersection. The adversarial agent (pedestrian, car, cyclist, or motorcycle) should perform an unexpected behavior that may lead to a collision. Keep it to one or two short sentences.
descriptions: An autonomous vehicle approaches a four-way intersection and begins to proceed when a cyclist unexpectedly swerves into the path, attempting to avoid a sudden obstacle.
A pedestrian suddenly darts from behind a parked bus and into the crosswalk just as the ego vehicle attempts to proceed through the intersection.
A cyclist unexpectedly enters the intersection from the wrong side, weaving between stopped vehicles and ignoring traffic signals.
While entering a four-way intersection in a moderate speed zone, a cyclist unexpectedly veers across the lane into the ego vehicle's path.
A pedestrian darts unexpectedly from behind a parked delivery truck directly into the crosswalk, forcing an immediate emergency brake maneuver.
